description: Read-only estimate for one Panel recruitment cycle. Returns per-interview and total credit cost, available balance and deficit, participant reward, card hold, recurrence, and a heuristic timeline. launch_panel shows this estimate for human App approval, or human chat confirmation in clients without Apps, before the paid request. The price and balance can change before launch; use submit_feasibility_request for incidence below 10% or more than 1,000 interviews.

country_code.description: Required explicit country code from userintuition://catalog/panel-countries. Never infer a country.

incident_rate.description: Percentage points. Values below 10 require submit_feasibility_request instead of direct launch.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.

name: estimate_panel

result.description: Read-only panel estimate for one recruitment cycle.
